brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Albania's cannabis traffic is no longer only one-way. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR ALBANIA
The arrest of the Albanian spy chief undermines trust in Albania's security institutions, a concern amplified by the country's link to 8 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [3][E2]

KEY RISKS
Albania's net energy import dependency of 27% exposes the country to potential supply disruptions. [E3]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the legal proceedings following the Albanian spy chief's arrest remains unresolved. [3]
